consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: authorisation of switching and access to apparatus
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: electrical release during an intrusive maintenance task on SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-9000 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 18 October 2016 an incident occurred on SG-9000 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
